title: Volume weighted average price
statementMd:
Volume-weighted average close per symbol (sum of close times volume divided by total volume), rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `symbol`, `vwap`.

Tables: `tickers`, `prices`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT symbol, ROUND(SUM(close * volume) * 1.0 / SUM(volume), 2) AS vwap FROM prices GROUP BY symbol;
```
